2022 MCM Problem C — Trading Strategies.

A trader starts with $1,000 on 2016-09-11.
The trading period runs from 2016-09-11 to 2021-09-10.
Gold may be traded only on days the market is open.
Bitcoin may be traded every day.
The commission for gold is 1% of the amount traded.
The commission for bitcoin is 2% of the amount traded.
The strategy may use only the past stream of daily prices.
It cannot see the future.
No look-ahead is allowed.
On 2021-09-10 the model must report the final portfolio value and justify that value.
Determine how sensitive the strategy is to transaction costs.
Communicate the result in a memorandum of at most two pages.
Price files are the supplied LBMA gold and Bitcoin series.
Do not execute trades while reading the problem.
